modified_caption: Ablation study results depicting accuracy percentages across two datasets, PHEME and PolitiFact. The bar charts compare six methodological variations: 'Ours,' 'w/o comments,' 'w/o text,' 'w/o select,' 'w/o emotion,' and 'w/o cognition.' The vertical axis, labeled 'Accuracy (%),' spans from 75% to 95% in 2.5% increments. In the PHEME dataset, the 'Ours' method achieves the highest accuracy at 89.84%, while 'w/o comments' stabilizes at approximately 86.82%. Notably, 'w/o text' exhibits a sharp decline to 78.50%, the lowest among all variations. The 'w/o select' method outperforms 'w/o emotion' by a narrow margin, recording 88.80% and 86.34%, respectively. For PolitiFact, the 'Ours' method again leads with 90.57%, followed by 'w/o select' at 89.62%. The 'w/o comments' and 'w/o text' methods demonstrate comparable performance, with accuracies of 85.85% and 83.02%, respectively. However, 'w/o emotion' consistently underperforms relative to 'w/o cognition,' achieving 82.91% compared to 87.74%. These results highlight the critical contributions of textual and emotional features to model accuracy, with selective components and cognitive elements playing a secondary yet significant role.

modifications.claim: 'w/o text' exhibits a sharp decline to 78.50% in the PHEME dataset.
modifications.reality: The actual value for 'w/o text' in the PHEME dataset is 80.10%, not 78.50%. The claim misrepresents the magnitude of the decline.

modifications.claim: 'w/o emotion' records 86.34% in the PHEME dataset, outperforming 'w/o cognition' at 87.17%.
modifications.reality: The values are reversed: 'w/o emotion' is 87.34%, and 'w/o cognition' is 87.17%. The claim incorrectly swaps their relative performance.

modifications.claim: 'w/o emotion' consistently underperforms relative to 'w/o cognition' in the PolitiFact dataset, achieving 82.91%.
modifications.reality: The actual value for 'w/o emotion' in PolitiFact is 84.91%, not 82.91%. The claim also misrepresents the trend by suggesting consistent underperformance, which is not supported by the data.
